The issuer shows a very strong balance sheet and liquidity profile (current ratio 1.92, equity of 29,833M against 21,966M liabilities), plus substantial retained earnings and an exceptionally high EBIT margin of about 44%. These metrics support a high investment-grade assessment, though without stronger evidence on cash flow stability, debt servicing, and scale, the profile looks somewhat short of the very highest categories.

DECISION: AA-
